story: A seller checks its local API, publishes a tested service, tracks usage and confirmed payments, and receives a purchase-backed review.
scope: Configured loopback sellers only; external hosting and open Internet enrollment remain deferred.
coverage: Settlement timestamp rather than quote timestamp
Pending and unknown amounts excluded from settled volume
Cross-seller buyer spending and shared budget
Exact integer formatting beyond JavaScript safe integers
Public usage sharing defaults off and respects recovery lock
Buyer EIP-191 review signature and independent chain receipt check
Wrong wallet, proof tampering, expired and changed review rejection
One vote per buyer, edits and identical retry handling
Old challenge cannot overwrite newer review
Receipt cannot review a different listing
Gateway uses original seller/session and redacts malformed upstream data
Mobile registration, reviews and analytics at 360px

source_candidate.dependency_install: passed against installed Hermes core constraints

privacy.reviews: Short reviewer identifier, purchased revision, rating, comment, verification mode and time

limits: Live wallet check uses an automated EIP-1193 bridge, not a human-operated wallet extension
Reviews prove purchase, not independence or quality; wallet collusion remains possible
Purchase-to-service association trusts the seller attestation; the transfer is checked independently
Usage is derived from local durable ledgers; a restored snapshot can be incomplete
Settled volume is gross testnet USDC, not fiat revenue or profit
